newsitem.title: USA: Humana unit rating under review - A.M. Best.
newsitem.headline: Humana unit rating under review - A.M. Best.

text.p: A.M. Best Co on Thursday said it placed the rating of Humana Health Plan of Ohio, a unit of Humana Inc, under review with positive implications.
A.M. Best said the rating action followed Humana's agreement to purchase ChoiceCare Corp, the largest health maintenance organization in Cincinnati, for $250 million.
The rating will remain under review until the transaction closes, which is expected to occur in the fall of 1997.
Depending on the outcome, A.M. Best said it could raise the current "B++" (very good) rating of Humana Health Plan of Ohio.
A.M. Best said it viewed the proposed acquisition as fitting Humana's strategy of building up its presence in select local markets.
"It would greatly enhance Humana's market presence and HMO membership leverage capabilities in the Cincinnati market while providing a platform for Ohio enrollment growth," A.M. Best said.
